Fixed bugs where the distance limit for Pointer-Dash could fail and where it could trigger double cooldowns.
Enhanced the blind zone experience—clear prompts will now appear when Retrace anchor points are within blind zones.
Fixed a bug where Korean language localization detection could fail.
Optimized the判定 timing for assisted dash.
Fixed a bug where assisted dash判定 could activate even when Retrace was unavailable.
Fixed incorrect health values during phase transitions in the Instructor Boss rematch.

Official Version v1.1.2686 【Major Update】
【Specialized Training】feature implemented, now accessible in the Training Area.
【Boss Rematch】feature implemented, now accessible in the Training Area.
【Reset Iteration System】feature implemented; node resets can now be performed in the Iteration System interface.
Added new Iteration Nodes 【Recycle】and 【Checkout】, replacing the original nodes 【Cancel】and 【Refresh】. The effects of the original nodes will now take effect as permanent initial effects.
Added skip functionality to certain animations.
Optimized ground detection for some skills (e.g., using Pointer-Dash on a submerged Black Deer will no longer cause the player to get stuck underground).
Fixed a bug where the UI display for the Light Trail ability could be missing during initialization.
Optimized the placement of a specific ranged enemy in the tutorial level.
Improved the flow of the "Return to Motherboard" tutorial.
Enhanced the damage output of certain active modules.
Optimized the switching operations in the in-game main interface.

Official Version v1.0.2514 Update
Adjusted the default overall graphics settings from "Ultra High" to "High".
Optimized the UI operation logic on the start screen; the "Continue Game" button will now be automatically selected based on the situation.
Changed the default difficulty to "Semi-Auto Mode".
Adjusted the order of pages in the game settings menu for new games.
Fixed a bug where the module "Retrace-Slash" caused permanent invisibility for the player.
Fixed a bug where the second teleportation of the module "Pointer-Dash" caused incorrect character rotation.

Optimized rotation interpolation to ensure normal behavior of most rotations under different gravity directions, including but not limited to Jiu, the camera, directional markers, and idle swords following behind.
Fixed an issue where "Overload-type" modules behaved incorrectly under unconventional gravity directions, potentially causing excessive displacement and bugs.
Optimized the usage effect and blocking detection of the "Pointer-Return" module; it can now adapt to different gravity directions, and its return speed has been reduced.
Gravity transition staircases will no longer cut off the player's Light Trail.
Improved the visual appearance of particles in black mist and appropriately reduced their quantity.
Optimized certain falling hitboxes to prevent premature damage locking under specific conditions.
Fixed collision issues in the "Resistor-07" boss battle scene that could cause Resistor-07 to get stuck in walls.
Enhanced the information display for Minor Modules; upgrade effects are now visible.
Fixed a bug where canceling training in the Training Area could cause the menu interface to become stuck.
Fixed a bug where canceling training at the start of module trials could leave module devices remaining.
【Spoiler Warning】
Fixed a bug where picking up a shadow too early during a specific skill of the boss "BFF" could cause the boss battle to become unable to continue.
Fixed a bug where triangular floor panels were missing in Phase 2 of the Meta Boss battle.

Thank you for purchasing and playing the official version of *Retrace the Light*. If you enjoyed the experience after completing the game, we'd greatly appreciate a positive review! For any questions or suggestions, feel free to share them in the comments section or our QQ group.
